cases.sql: CREATE TYPE enum_generated_label AS ENUM ('first','last'); ALTER TYPE enum_generated_label ADD VALUE 'middle' BEFORE 'last'

CREATE TABLE enum_generated_values (id integer PRIMARY KEY, l enum_generated_label, r enum_generated_label, cmp integer GENERATED ALWAYS AS (enum_cmp(l,r)) STORED, same boolean GENERATED ALWAYS AS (enum_eq(l,r)) STORED, small enum_generated_label GENERATED ALWAYS AS (enum_smaller(l,r)) STORED, high enum_generated_label GENERATED ALWAYS AS (greatest(l,r)) STORED, array_less boolean GENERATED ALWAYS AS (ARRAY[l] < ARRAY[r]) STORED, hash_same boolean GENERATED ALWAYS AS (hashenum(l)=hashenum(r)) STORED)
SELECT * FROM enum_generated_values ORDER BY id
UPDATE enum_generated_values SET l='first',r='middle' WHERE id=2
SELECT * FROM enum_generated_values ORDER BY id
ALTER TYPE enum_generated_label RENAME VALUE 'middle' TO 'between'
SELECT * FROM enum_generated_values ORDER BY id
BEGIN; UPDATE enum_generated_values SET l='last',r='between' WHERE id=1
SELECT * FROM enum_generated_values ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM enum_generated_values ORDER BY id
DROP TABLE enum_generated_values; DROP TYPE enum_generated_label
